It has a pleasant smell, and helps my dry hair retain some of its moisture.  I like that it is organic, and I feel good using it.

It lathered up, but when I let it sit for a couple of  minutes it seemed to have faded away.  I used no conditioner but my hair felt very soft afterwards. I'm always looking for organic products and this one definitely made a believer out of me.

claims.text: Many reviewers say the shampoo leaves their hair soft, silky, shiny, and moisturized.
A common complaint is that the shampoo is very drying, leaving hair brittle, frizzy, or matted.
Several reviewers praise it for improving dry, damaged, frizzy, or color-treated hair.
Some reviewers were disappointed with the product overall, citing issues like leaking bottles, lack of fragrance, or inability to return it.
A few reviewers note the shampoo does not lather much, though some see this as a positive.
